content.short: CoinStats is a free cryptocurrency portfolio management and DeFi wallet app.
content.description: CoinStats provides a platform to monitor and manage crypto, DeFi, and NFT assets. Each month, over 1.2 million active users track their portfolios in real time by linking more than 300 wallets and exchanges. The built-in DeFi wallet enables storage, buying, and swapping of crypto assets. Across the platform, more than $100 million in assets are managed. The app focuses on empowering users to efficiently oversee their crypto holdings through a straightforward, user-friendly experience.
